crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He…
In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boils and blisters breaking out on man and on…
Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can…
Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t…
therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
translations.bsb: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
translations.kjv: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
translations.asv: So Satan went forth from the presence of Jehovah, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
